major_disposition: The doc-sha-vs-port keying distinction is unreachable through the P4 admission machinery: a single admission's CAS always carries the document's full input set, so capturing 'input 1' and 'input 2' of one document separately requires two admissions, whose CAS are identical (idempotent), and capturing both inputs of one document against one root in a single batch is refused by the within-request duplicate check (trust.py:2445). The doc-sha keying is implemented (trust.py:2441 reads port['consumer_document_sha256']) and pinned by (a) test_stream_documents_derivation_returns_the_document_sha (derivation returns the 64-hex document sha, not a port), (b) test_same_document_cannot_capture_the_same_stream_twice (same document/port refused with match='already captured'), and (c) test_second_distinct_document_captures_the_same_publication (distinct documents succeed and carry distinct consumer_document_sha256). Residual gap (same-document-different-node/input behavioral pin) is documented as unreachable, not hidden.
